en: Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and not associated with a root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and associated with a root, by way of the root condition. [Under] the root [condition], three; ... pe ... [under] the non-disappearance [condition], three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, and dissociated from a root, there arises a state that is visible, reactive, and dissociated from a root, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root [condition], twenty-one; under the object [condition], ... pe ... [twenty-one].
Three ... [and so on] ... twenty-one in non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and both not-root and not-rootless, there arises a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, and both root and with-root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three in root ... [and so on] ... three in non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, neither-root-cause nor root, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, and both with-root-cause and not a root, by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, neither-root-cause nor dissociated from root, [there arises a state that is] non-visible, non-reacting...

A state that is both a cause and associated with a cause arises by way of the cause-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the cause [condition], there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance [condition], there are three.

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, not a cause, dissociated from a cause, and itself not a cause, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reacting, associated with a cause, and itself not a cause, by way of the cause-condition. (Abbreviated. Under the cause [condition], there are...

Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, not-root, and not-root-cause, there arises a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, not-root, and with-root-cause by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-visible, non-reactive, not-root, and not-root-cause, [there arises] a state that is visible and reactive ...
A non-causal, causeless state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-one;
under the predominance condition, twenty-one … pe … under the mutuality condition, three … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-one.
